origin: the later exit and the wait gate had no prose coverage — a discussion that spawns mid-conversation and keeps talking must stay honestly blocked: the spawn recorded with the conversation's knowledge, the later choice returning to the session loop, and the conclusion attempt meeting the engine-rendered wait gate instead of a completion the engine would refuse anyway
conduct: The user comes back to settle webhook timing and goes straight at it: how long should the checkout wait on the capture webhook before surfacing a pending state? Pressed for what the window rests on, they surface the ground truth — the vendor claims sub-second delivery, the design leans on that claim, and nobody has measured it against the real sandbox. They are clear that no amount of talking settles it: the number has to be collected properly before the window is worth choosing. Offered a controlled way to get it they take it — but they are not done talking, so asked whether to work the experiment now or keep going they keep going: there is a refund-notification wrinkle they want settled while it is fresh. They settle it decisively — refund webhooks reuse the capture consumer's idempotent path, no separate handler — and then ask to wrap the discussion up. Told what is open they agree to set the timing question aside for the close — the experiment will answer it. At the blocked conclusion they take the pause rather than keep talking. They introduce no other topics and never override a block.

stubs.discussion-review-clean: when the engine records a dispatch of kind review — write the content to the path the dispatch response returned
